name: ecommerce-checkout-api
description: Optional HTTP presentation for the Checkout module. A shopper surface addressed by the session token, whose placement endpoint carries the domain's idempotency contract onto the wire as an Idempotency-Key header with a distinct status for replay, conflict and in-flight; and a staff read surface behind the domain's policy. Registers nothing until the host opts a group in.
features: Checkout session creation from lines handed in
Consent capture with IP and user agent
Idempotent placement over an Idempotency-Key header
Distinct statuses for replay, payload conflict and in-flight
Staff read surface behind the domain policy
Structured operation logging without credentials or evidence
